entry.title: snprintf/sprintf/fprintf/vsnprintf are faithful in v1 today and carry ~3,200 leaves at near-zero function-cover yield: a LEAF-directed card, not a cover card
entry.why: Card W37-CORPUS-CONTRACTS-4 read them and declined them deliberately, on blast radius rather than faithfulness. There is NO vocabulary gap, and the reason is the exact inverse of LIBC-MEM-RESULT-ALIAS: their result is `int`, a SCALAR, so resource_return_none() is literally faithful rather than a conservative approximation; their buffer parameter is written through, which msgpack_packer_init's `pk` already establishes as borrowed; and their variadic tail is mk_print's resource_variadic_data_tail(). snprintf alone carries 1,044 leaves against a function-cover yield of ONE (rd_kafka_mk_nodename, itself forecast to exchange - its tail passes a `const char *` formal, the shape MK-PRINT-TAIL-ACTUALS measured refusing at 26 sites); sprintf's single target cJSON_Version returns a `static` local array, an independent exchange risk. Deciding 1,044 leaves inside a cover arbiter whose other declarations must each be attributable leaf by leaf would have made that card's movement unreadable, for one function. Discharge condition: A dedicated leaf-directed card landing the family together with its own leaf-by-leaf attribution, rather than smuggling one member into a cover card.

ground: Its discharge condition is a dedicated leaf-directed card landing the family together with its own leaf-by-leaf attribution. Card W43-LIBC-PRINTF-FAMILY declared printf, fprintf, snprintf and sprintf in providers/quirin-provider-libc/contracts/libc/stdio.qcore (all-borrowed, resource_variadic_data_tail(), resource_return_none()), each agreeing with the declared ABI in all 168 units that declare it, and ran a four-stage arbiter attributed per member: 2,212 uncontracted-callee leaves removed (printf 22, fprintf 1,138, snprintf 1,044, sprintf 8), 2,229 leaves removed and 1,283 added in all, every one attributed; five functions Unknown -> Safe (cmt_errno_print, ctr_errno_print, cio_errno_print, rd_kafka_mk_nodename, cJSON_Version), neither forecast exchange firing; 0 unit moves; leak 272. The va_list members are refused by name on a measured reader ground (LIBC-PRINTF-VA-LIST), and the exchange is registered as LIBC-PRINTF-TAIL-ACTUALS and LIBC-PRINTF-NESTED-TAIL-CALLEES. docs/reports/w43-libc-printf-family/README.md.
